name: fix142_ledge_chase

notes: Case 1: the owner's spot, the Trelis ravine (Trelis_Level_Dungeon_01_03 floor -11.1 m, the landscape rim 1.7 m, 12.7 m above). '[combat] ... chase A -> B' lines give the way (Straight / Path / Unreachable) and the plan; '... retreats from' starts a give-up. chaseway / chaseunreachable / retreating / ignoresunreachable probe the rest.
